status: external inputs; fetched and hash-checked by fetch_inputs.py; ignored by Git
publication_note: Takahashi's charging table is part of WRF-ELEC (MicroTed/wrf4-elec), whose LICENSE.txt is the WRF notice placing the code in the public domain; it is fetched at a pinned commit. The CRAC:CRII tables are the Oulu cosmic-ray ionization model's pre-calculated tables, whose README asks users to cite Usoskin and Kovaltsov (2006) and Usoskin, Kovaltsov and Mironova (2010). The PDG table is the Particle Data Group's public muon energy-loss table for dry air. None of the files is redistributed by this repository. A hash mismatch means the upstream bytes changed and must be reviewed, never silently accepted.

files.name: takahashi.txt
files.credit: Charge per graupel-crystal collision (fC) after Takahashi (1978, J. Atmos. Sci. 35, 1536), as tabulated by Wojcik (1994) and used in WRF-ELEC (Mansell et al. 2005, J. Geophys. Res. 110, D12101).

files.name: CRII_tables.zip
files.credit: CRAC:CRII v2 cosmic-ray induced ionization tables (ion pairs per gram per second by depth, cutoff rigidity and modulation potential): Usoskin and Kovaltsov (2006, J. Geophys. Res. 111, D21206); Usoskin, Kovaltsov and Mironova (2010, J. Geophys. Res. 115, D10302).
files.use: cosmic-ray ionization above Earth's sea-level depth

files.name: muE_air_dry_1_atm.txt
files.credit: Muon energy loss and range in dry air (Particle Data Group, Atomic and Nuclear Properties, 2024; format of Groom, Mokhov and Striganov 2001, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 78, 183).
files.use: muon stopping power for the ionization they make
